### Setup project and run tests

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/packages/bun-plugin-yaml/README.md

Install dependencies and execute the test suite when contributing to the plugin.

```bash
$ bun install # project setup
$ bun test # run tests
```

--------------------------------

### Configure local template setup logic in `package.json`

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/runtime/templating/create.mdx

Defines `preinstall`, `postinstall`, and `start` scripts in the `bun-create` section of a local template's `package.json`.

```json
{
  "name": "@bun-examples/simplereact",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "main": "index.js",
  "dependencies": {
    "react": "^17.0.2",
    "react-dom": "^17.0.2"
  },
  "bun-create": {
    "preinstall": "echo 'Installing...'", // a single command
    "postinstall": ["echo 'Done!'"], // an array of commands
    "start": "bun run echo 'Hello world!'"
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Install and run global packages

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/pm/cli/install.mdx

Use the -g or --global flag with bun install to install command-line tools globally, followed by example output when running the installed tool.

```bash
bun install --global cowsay # or `bun install -g cowsay`
cowsay "Bun!"
```

```txt
 ______
< Bun! >
 ------
        \   ^__^
         \  (oo)\_______
            (__)\       )/\
                ||----w |
                ||     ||
```

### Install Bun in GitHub Actions with setup-bun

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/install/cicd.mdx

Use the official oven-sh/setup-bun action in a GitHub Actions runner step to install Bun and execute commands like bun install.

```yaml
name: my-workflow
jobs:
  my-job:
    name: my-job
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # ...
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 # [!code ++]

      # run any `bun` or `bunx` command
      - run: bun install # [!code ++]
```

### Set the installation strategy using the --linker flag

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/pm/isolated-installs.mdx

Pass `--linker isolated` or `--linker hoisted` to `bun install` to choose between strict dependency isolation and traditional flattened installs.

```bash
# Use isolated installs
bun install --linker isolated

# Use traditional hoisted installs
bun install --linker hoisted
```

--------------------------------

### Add start script to package.json

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/quickstart.mdx

Configure a start script in package.json to run the TypeScript entrypoint with Bun.

```json
{
  "name": "my-app",
  "module": "index.ts",
  "type": "module",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": { // [!code ++]
    "start": "bun run index.ts" // [!code ++]
  }, // [!code ++]
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/bun": "latest"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "typescript": "^7"
  }
}
```

--------------------------------

### Set up toolchains and run homepage benchmarks

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/bench/site/README.md

Sets up required toolchains and repositories, then executes the benchmark suite using a specified Bun binary under test. Supports running full suites, specific sub-benchmarks, or quick smoke tests via environment variables.

```sh
bench/site/setup-toolchains.sh                      # node, deno, pnpm/yarn/npm, bun release + canary -> $SITEBENCH_HOME/toolchains
bench/site/setup-repos.sh                           # rolldown/benchmarks clone + deps of bench/express, bench/websocket-server, bench/postgres
BUN=/abs/path/to/bun bench/site/run-all.sh          # everything: bundler http ws postgres install (~30 min with RUNS=3)
BUN=/abs/path/to/bun bench/site/run-all.sh http ws  # a subset
RUNS=1 BUN=... bench/site/run-all.sh                # quick smoke run
```

### Autolink URLs with fragments

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/test/js/bun/md/spec-permissive-autolinks.txt

Parses optional URL fragments starting with '#' appended to the domain or path.

```example
https://example.com#fragment
.
<p><a href="https://example.com#fragment">https://example.com#fragment</a></p>
.
--fpermissive-url-autolinks
```

### Autolink URLs with paths

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/test/js/bun/md/spec-permissive-autolinks.txt

Matches optional URL paths starting with '/' and delimited by slashes. Non-alphanumerical characters (., -, _) in path components must be bounded by alphanumerical characters.

```example
https://example.com/images/branding/logo_272x92.png
.
<p><a href="https://example.com/images/branding/logo_272x92.png">https://example.com/images/branding/logo_272x92.png</a></p>
.
--fpermissive-url-autolinks
```

--------------------------------

### Get current file name with import.meta.file

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/util/import-meta-file.mdx

Use `import.meta.file` to retrieve the filename of the currently executing module (for example, evaluating inside `/a/b/c.ts` returns `"c.ts"`).

```ts
import.meta.file; // => "c.ts"
```

### Define an HTTP route and start an Elysia server in server.ts

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/ecosystem/elysia.mdx

Define a GET route at root using Elysia and listen on port 8080. Logs the running server port using the app.server instance.

```ts
import { Elysia } from "elysia";

const app = new Elysia().get("/", () => "Hello Elysia").listen(8080);

console.log(`🦊 Elysia is running on port ${app.server?.port}...`);
```

### Configure and sort imports using @trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports in .prettierrc

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/runtime/format.mdx

Configure import sorting order and specifier options in `.prettierrc` alongside an example TypeScript file showing sorted imports. `bun format` handles sorting without needing the plugin to be installed.

```json
{
  "plugins": ["@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports"],
  "importOrder": ["<BUILTIN_MODULES>", "<THIRD_PARTY_MODULES>", "^@/(.*)$", "^[./]"],
  "importOrderSeparation": true,
  "importOrderSortSpecifiers": true
}
```

```ts
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";

import { z } from "zod";

import { db } from "@/db";

import { a, b } from "./util";
```

### Global test setup with beforeAll and afterAll hooks

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/test/configuration.mdx

Define database setup and teardown handlers using `bun:test` hooks in a preload script.

```typescript
// Global test setup
import { beforeAll, afterAll } from "bun:test";

beforeAll(() => {
  // Set up test database
  setupTestDatabase();
});

afterAll(() => {
  // Clean up
  cleanupTestDatabase();
});
```

### Install Bun across platforms

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/README.md

Installs Bun using various package managers and platform-specific methods including the install script, PowerShell, npm, Homebrew, and Docker.

```sh
# with install script (recommended)
curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash

# on windows
powershell -c "irm bun.sh/install.ps1 | iex"

# with npm
npm install -g bun

# with Homebrew
brew tap oven-sh/bun
brew install bun

# with Docker
docker pull oven/bun
docker run --rm --init --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 oven/bun
```

### Install specific workspace dependencies with bun install --filter

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/pm/workspaces.mdx

Installs dependencies selectively for specific workspace packages by name pattern or directory path while excluding others.

```bash
# Install dependencies for all workspaces starting with `pkg-` except for `pkg-c`
bun install --filter "pkg-*" --filter "!pkg-c"

# Paths can also be used. This is equivalent to the command above.
bun install --filter "./packages/pkg-*" --filter "!pkg-c" # or --filter "!./packages/pkg-c"
```

# View basic package information
bun info is-number

# View a specific version
bun info is-number@7.0.0

# View all available versions
bun info is-number versions

# View package dependencies
bun info express dependencies

# View package homepage
bun info lodash homepage

# Get JSON output
bun info react --json
```

--------------------------------

### build.onStart

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/bundler/plugins.mdx

Registers a callback that executes when the bundler starts a new bundle build. Bun waits until all onStart callbacks complete before continuing with the build process.

```APIDOC
## build.onStart(callback)

### Description
Registers a callback that runs when the bundler starts a new bundle. The bundler pauses until all `onStart` callbacks complete (including async promises).

### Signature
```ts
onStart(callback: () => void | Promise<void>): void;
```

### Parameters
- **callback** (`() => void | Promise<void>`) - Required - A function executed when the build starts. Can return a Promise.

### Example
```ts
build.onStart(async () => {
  console.log("Bundle started!");
  await Bun.sleep(1000);
});
```

### Notes
- `onStart()` callbacks cannot modify the `build.config` object. Mutate `build.config` directly within the `setup()` function instead.
```

### build.onStart(callback)

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/runtime/plugins.mdx

Registers a lifecycle callback that executes when the bundler starts a new bundle. Bun waits until all onStart callbacks have resolved before continuing the bundling process.

```APIDOC
## build.onStart

### Description
Registers a callback that runs when the bundler starts a new bundle. The callback may be asynchronous, and the bundler waits until all `onStart()` callbacks have completed before proceeding. Lifecycle callbacks cannot modify `build.config`.

### Signature
```ts
onStart(callback: () => void | Promise<void>): void;
```

### Parameters
- **callback** (`() => void | Promise<void>`) - Required. A function to execute at the start of bundling. Can return a Promise.

### Return Value
- **void**

### Example
```ts
import type { BunPlugin } from "bun";

const myPlugin: BunPlugin = {
  name: "onStart example",
  setup(build) {
    build.onStart(async () => {
      console.log("Bundle started!");
      await Bun.sleep(1000);
    });
  },
};
```
```

--------------------------------

### Start service immediately

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/ecosystem/systemd.mdx

Starts the systemd service manually without needing to reboot.

```bash
systemctl start my-app
```

--------------------------------

### Start a simple HTTP server with Bun.serve

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/http/simple.mdx

Starts an HTTP server listening on port 3000 that responds to every request with status 200 and "Welcome to Bun!".

```typescript
const server = Bun.serve({
  port: 3000,
  fetch(request) {
    return new Response("Welcome to Bun!");
  },
});

console.log(`Listening on ${server.url}`);
```

--------------------------------

### Inheriting install settings in bunfig.toml

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/test/configuration.mdx

Configure [install] settings like registry, exact, and prefer alongside [test] options in bunfig.toml. bun test inherits network and package installation settings during test execution.

```toml
[install]
# These settings are inherited by bun test
registry = "https://npm.company.com/"
exact = true
prefer = "offline"

[test]
# Test-specific configuration
coverage = true
```

--------------------------------

### onStart(callback)

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/runtime/plugins.mdx

Registers a callback that runs once the bundler has started a bundle. It can be used for initialization before module resolution begins.

```APIDOC
## onStart(callback)

### Description
Run once the bundler has started a bundle.

### Signature
```ts
onStart(callback: () => void | Promise<void>): void;
```

### Parameters
- **callback** (`() => void | Promise<void>`) - Function invoked when the bundling process begins.
```

### Install Prisma CLI, Client, and Postgres adapter

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/ecosystem/prisma-postgres.mdx

Installs the prisma CLI as a development dependency alongside @prisma/client and @prisma/adapter-pg.

```bash
bun add -d prisma
bun add @prisma/client @prisma/adapter-pg
```

--------------------------------

### Install project dependencies

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/test/integration/expo-app/README.md

Installs the required package dependencies for the Expo project using npm.

```bash
npm install
```

### Configure [install] section in bunfig.toml

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/runtime/bunfig.mdx

Configures general package manager behavior for bun install.

```toml
[install]
# configuration here
```

--------------------------------

### Configure bunfig.toml and run Fullstack Dev Server

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/packages/bun-plugin-svelte/README.md

Register bun-plugin-svelte under serve.static plugins in bunfig.toml, then run the dev server with an HTML entrypoint.

```toml
[serve.static]
plugins = ["bun-plugin-svelte"]

```

```sh
$ bun index.html

```

--------------------------------

### Start the Fullstack Dev Server

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/bundler/fullstack.mdx

Runs the application server script using Bun CLI.

```bash
bun run app.ts
```

--------------------------------

### Install LLVM on Ubuntu/Debian

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/project/contributing.mdx

Run the automatic LLVM installation script compatible with all versions of Ubuntu.

```bash
# LLVM has an automatic installation script that is compatible with all versions of Ubuntu
wget https://apt.llvm.org/llvm.sh -O - | sudo bash -s -- 23 all
```

--------------------------------

### Run initial Prisma database migration

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/guides/ecosystem/prisma-postgres.mdx

Creates and applies the initial SQL migration to the PostgreSQL database. Pass --env-file=.env because Bun does not load .env automatically when executing CLIs with --bun.

```bash
bun run --bun --env-file=.env prisma migrate dev --name init
```

```txt
Loaded Prisma config from prisma.config.ts.

Prisma schema loaded from prisma/schema.prisma.
Datasource "db": PostgreSQL database "mydb", schema "public" at "localhost:5432"

Applying migration `20250114141233_init`

The following migration(s) have been created and applied from new schema changes:

prisma/migrations/
  └─ 20250114141233_init/
    └─ migration.sql

Your database is now in sync with your schema.
```

### Install LLVM on macOS using Homebrew

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/project/contributing.mdx

Install LLVM 23 on macOS using Homebrew.

```bash
brew install llvm@23
```

### Install dependencies on openSUSE Tumbleweed with zypper

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/project/contributing.mdx

Installs the necessary build packages on openSUSE Tumbleweed.

```bash
sudo zypper install go cmake ninja automake git icu rustup
```

--------------------------------

### Start an HTTP server with Bun.serve

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/runtime/bun-apis.mdx

Starts an HTTP server using `Bun.serve` with standard `Request` and `Response` objects in server.ts.

```ts
Bun.serve({
  fetch(req: Request) {
    return new Response("Success!");
  },
});
```

### Install dependencies on Arch Linux with pacman

Source: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/blob/main/docs/project/contributing.mdx

Installs required build dependencies on Arch Linux.

```bash
sudo pacman -S base-devel cmake git go libiconv libtool make ninja pkg-config python rustup sed unzip ruby
```
